title.en: Italian PM Meloni says she was ‘astonished’ by Trump claims that she ‘begged’ him for a photo - as it happened
title.zh: 欧盟领导人签署支持乌克兰的联合声明 - 欧洲实时报道

summary.en: EU and G7 leaders have issued joint statements supporting Ukraine and urging Russia to participate in peace negotiations. This comes amidst ongoing international diplomatic efforts and a separate emerging transatlantic political discussion involving US president Donald Trump and Italian prime minister Giorgia Meloni.
summary.zh: 欧盟和七国集团领导人发表联合声明，支持乌克兰并呼吁俄罗斯参与和平进程。此前，国际社会已展开多轮外交努力，同时，美国前总统唐纳德·特朗普与意大利总理乔治亚·梅洛尼之间也出现了一场新的跨大西洋政治讨论。

body.en:
Meanwhile, a new transatlantic drama is emerging in Italy , after US president Donald Trump told an Italian broadcaster that prime minister Giorgia Meloni “begged” him for a picture on the sidelines of the G7 summit earlier this week.

“ She begged me to take a picture with her! She wanted a picture with me so badly. I wouldn’t have taken it, but I felt sorry for her.”

Extraordinarily, Meloni immediately took to social media to respond, posting a short video clip and saying “neither I nor Italy ever beg” anyone for anything.

The Italian PM said she was “astonished” by “completely made up” claims by Trump.

“ I don’t know why the president of the United States behaves like this towards his allies: it is not the first time. I can only say it is disappointing that he does not show the same determination with the enemies of the ⁠West and of the United States, whose leaders he instead treats with far ​greater indulgence.”

Italy’s foreign minister Antonio Tajani also cancelled his planned trip to the US in response.

“The serious and offensive words of president Trump towards prime minister Giorgia Meloni offend all of Italy. For this reason, I have decided to cancel my visit to the United States scheduled for the next 21 and 22 June,” he said on X.
body.zh: 本周早些时候，七国集团领导人也采取了类似举措，呼吁俄罗斯参与和平进程。与此同时，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对一家意大利广播公司表示，总理乔治亚·梅洛尼本周早些时候在七国集团峰会间隙“恳求”他拍一张照片，之后意大利正在上演一出新的跨大西洋大戏。据报道，特朗普在接受 La7 广播公司采访时说道：“她求我和她合影！她非常想和我合影。我不会拍，但我为她感到难过。” “我不知道美国总统为什么对他的盟友做出这样的行为：这不是第一次了。我只能说，令人失望的是，他没有对西方和美国的敌人表现出同样的决心，相反，他对西方和美国的领导人表现出更大的宽容。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: In a world grappling with conflict, the efforts of leaders to call for peace and engagement remind us of the profound value of peacemaking. Yahweh blesses those who actively work to bridge divides and seek reconciliation, reflecting His own desire for harmony among nations. Such diplomatic endeavors, though challenging, are vital steps towards a more...
reflection.zh: 在一个充满冲突的世界里，各国领导人呼吁和平与参与的努力，提醒我们缔造和平的深远价值。雅伟赐福那些积极弥合分歧、寻求和解的人，这反映了祂自己对各国之间和谐的渴望。这些外交努力，尽管充满挑战，却是迈向更和平未来的重要一步。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: US official says Israel-Hezbollah ceasefire agreed as Trump lashes out Iran deal critics – Middle East crisis live
title.zh: 中东危机：以色列打击黎巴嫩目标，美伊瑞士会谈取消

summary.en: Israeli forces conducted strikes in Lebanon, claiming an Iran-backed group had repeatedly violated a ceasefire. Concurrently, US-Iran talks scheduled for Friday in Switzerland were abruptly called off.
summary.zh: 以色列国防军声称，在伊朗支持的团体多次违反停火协议后，以色列继续对黎巴嫩境内的目标进行打击。与此同时，原定于周五在瑞士举行的美伊会谈突然取消。

body.en:
Reuters has issued an alert saying Israel and Hezbollah have agreed to a ceasefire starting today at 4pm local time, according to a senior US official.

“Hezbollah and ‌Israel have agreed ‌to a ceasefire,” the official said on background, adding that negotiators ‌for the US and Qataris worked ​out the deal with help from Iran.

“We understand ⁠that after the ​exchange of ​fire ​earlier today, Israel and ​Hezbollah ‌are ​now ​in a ceasefire.”
body.zh: 以色列国防军声称，在伊朗支持的组织多次违反停火协议后，以色列国防军继续发动袭击； JD万斯取消了行程，因为定于周五举行的美伊会谈被取消 在瑞士举行的美伊会谈突然取消 JD万斯告诉以色列的伊朗协议批评者：特朗普是你们在世界上唯一的盟友 黎巴嫩国营国家通讯社表示，至少有16人在以色列的空袭中丧生，以色列军方称空袭正在进行，而真主党则表示黎巴嫩南部发生了激烈的战斗。这场战斗对美伊关于结束战争的新协议构成了威胁，该协议要求立即停止“包括黎巴嫩在内的所有战线”的军事行动。万斯猛烈抨击以色列对伊朗协议的批评者，称唐纳德·特朗普是以色列在世界上唯一的盟友，并严厉谴责以色列从美国获得的数十亿美元的国防援助。万斯告诉记者，特朗普“是全世界唯一一位此时此刻同情以色列国的国家元首”。特朗普表示，美国期望“在所有战线上实现全面停火，包括黎巴嫩、真主党和以色列”，并在社交媒体帖子中补充道：“我们鼓励中东地区的每个人继续致力于让我们的谈判顺利展开。”伊朗最高领导人表示，尽管有“不同观点”，但他还是批准了与美国的协议，但没有详细说明。阿亚图拉·莫杰塔巴·哈梅内伊在国家电视台上宣读的消息中说：“原则上，我对谅解备忘录有不同的看法，但我发出了我的许可，因为尊敬的[伊朗]总统作为最高国家安全委员会主席，代表他本人和其他成员向我做出了保护伊朗民族和抵抗阵线权利的承诺。”哈梅内伊在周四的信息中——他对伊朗与美国协议的第一反应——声称特朗普“出于绝望”“使用了各种手段”来确保该协议。美国总统声称该协议是华盛顿的胜利，避免了“全球萧条”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of renewed strikes and cancelled diplomatic talks highlights the profound challenge of maintaining peace in a volatile region. Yahweh's word reminds us to pursue peace whenever possible, recognizing the complex realities that often hinder such efforts. Even when peace seems elusive, the call to strive for it remains a constant aspiration.
reflection.zh: 恢复打击和取消外交会谈的消息，凸显了在动荡地区维持和平的巨大挑战。雅伟的话语提醒我们，只要可能，就当竭力追求和平，同时也要认识到阻碍这些努力的复杂现实。即使和平看似遥不可及，追求和平的呼召仍是一个永恒的愿望。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Barack Obama says US is ‘worse off’ than before war with Iran
title.zh: 奥巴马称美国在与伊朗的战争后状况更糟

summary.en: Former President Barack Obama stated that after 15 weeks of war with Iran, the United States is now in a worse position than before the conflict began. He expressed satisfaction with the current ceasefire and hopes it will be sustained.
summary.zh: 前总统巴拉克·奥巴马表示，在与伊朗进行了15周的战争之后，美国现在的状况比战争开始前更糟。他对目前的停火感到满意，并希望停火能够持续下去。

body.en: Former president nevertheless said in an interview that he was happy to see a ceasefire with Iran and hopes it holds Analysis: Iran peace deal makes clear how far US has been forced to retreat since 2025 Barack Obama has said that after 15 weeks of war with Iran , the US is now “worse off” than before the conflict started in February. “We’ve now fought a war, spent billions and billions of dollars, you know, put enormous strain on our military. A lot of people have died. And it feels like we’re back where we were before we started the war, except maybe a little bit worse off,” the former US president told NBC News in an interview that aired on Friday. body.zh: 不过，前总统在接受采访时表示，他很高兴看到与伊朗停火，并希望停火能够继续下去。 分析：伊朗和平协议清楚表明美国自 2025 年以来被迫后退的程度 巴拉克·奥巴马 (Barack Obama) 表示，在与伊朗战争 15 周后，美国现在的状况比 2 月份冲突开始前“更糟”。这位美国前总统在周五播出的采访中告诉 NBC 新闻：“我们现在打了一场战争，花费了数十亿美元，给我们的军队带来了巨大的压力。很多人死了。感觉我们又回到了战争开始前的状态，只是情况可能更糟了一点。”继续阅读...

Yahweh's word reminds us that violence often begets further suffering, emphasizing the self-destructive nature of taking up the sword. This sobering truth calls us to seek paths of peace that truly heal and...
reflection.zh: 前总统对与伊朗战争的反思，凸显了冲突的巨大代价，即使停火也让国家“状况更糟”。雅伟的话语提醒我们，暴力往往会带来更多的苦难，强调了动用武力的自我毁灭性。这一发人深省的真理呼唤我们寻求真正医治和恢复的和平之路，而不仅仅是暂停敌对行动。

title.en: Six-year-old Ebola patient taken from DR Congo hospital found and 'doing well'
title.zh: 从刚果民主共和国医院带走的六岁埃博拉患者被发现并“状况良好”

summary.en: Health facilities have come under attack during the current outbreak as a result of misinformation and fear.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A six-year-old Ebola patient, who Congolese authorities were searching for after armed men stormed the hospital where she was being treated, has been found and is "doing well", a local health official has told the BBC.

On Wednesday, Dr Lubambo Maboko Gaston said that a girl and her mother had been taken by "very angry" men from a hospital in the eastern city of Butembo, two days previously.

It is unclear whether the men were known to the child, but suspicion and fear surrounding Ebola treatment centres have been rife during the current outbreak.

On Friday, Gaston said the child and mother had turned up at an Ebola treatment centre roughly 18km (11 miles) from Butembo.

Ebola treatment facilities have come under attack multiple times during the ongoing outbreak, in which more than 230 deaths and 890 cases have been confirmed.

Last month, police in the town of Mongbwalu fired shots in the air after angry crowds attempted to reclaim the bodies of loved ones who had died at a health facility.

Days before, crowds set fire to isolation tents in hospital in Rwampara - a town 85km (53 miles) south-east of Mongbwalu - after they were prevented from taking the body of a man thought to have died from Ebola.

The body of an Ebola victim is highly infectious and can lead to the virus spreading further when prepared for burial. Ensuring that burials are carried out safely is a key concern for health official trying to tackle the outbreak.

"People are not properly informed or sensitised about what is happening. For a certain segment of the population, especially in remote areas, Ebola is an invention by outsiders - it does not exist," local politician Luc Malembe told the BBC last month.

"They believe it is the NGOs and hospitals creating this to make money, and this is tragic."

The Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo was declared on May 15, though transmission had been going undetected for some time.

The surge in cases has been caused by a rare species of Ebola known as Bundibugyo. There is currently no vaccine for this species and the World Health Organisation has said it could take months for a jab to be ready.

The current Ebola outbreak has the potential to be one of the largest ever, the head of Africa's Centres for Disease ​Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) said on Tuesday, echoing a similar projection made earlier this month by the US CDC.

Uganda, which shares a border with DR Congo, has reported 19 confirmed cases of the virus, including two deaths.

However, it has not reported any new cases since 5 June, the World Health Organisation (WHO) has said.

In DR Congo, the health ministry says it has stepped up surveillance systems, contact tracing and treatment infrastructure, with dedicated centres in several affected towns.

body.zh: 当地一名卫生官员告诉英国广播公司，一名六岁的埃博拉患者已被找到，目前“情况良好”。刚果当局在武装人员冲进她接受治疗的医院后正在寻找她。 周三，卢班博·马博科·加斯顿博士表示，两天前，一名女孩和她的母亲被“非常愤怒”的男子从东部城市布滕博的一家医院带走。 目前尚不清楚孩子是否认识这些人，但在当前的疫情爆发期间，围绕埃博拉治疗中心的怀疑和恐惧一直很普遍。 周五，加斯顿说，孩子和母亲来到了距离布滕博约 18 公里（11 英里）的埃博拉治疗中心。 埃博拉治疗设施在埃博拉疫情持续期间多次遭受攻击，已确认超过230人死亡、890例病例。 上个月，愤怒的人群试图收回在医疗机构去世的亲人的尸体后，蒙布瓦鲁镇的警察向空中开枪。 几天前，人群在蒙布瓦鲁东南 85 公里（53 英里）的小镇鲁万帕拉 (Rwampara) 医院里放火焚烧隔离帐篷，因为他们被阻止带走一名被认为死于埃博拉病毒的男子的尸体。 埃博拉病毒受害者的尸体具有高度传染性，在准备埋葬时可能会导致病毒进一步传播。确保安全地进行埋葬是卫生官员应对疫情的一个关键问题。 “人们对正在发生的事情没有适当的了解或敏感。对于某些人群，特别是在偏远地区，埃博拉病毒是局外人的发明 - 它并不存在，”当地政治家卢克·马伦贝上个月告诉英国广播公司。 “他们认为非政府组织和医院创造这个是为了赚钱，这是悲剧。” 刚果民主共和国东部地区于 5 月 15 日宣布爆发埃博拉疫情，但一段时间以来一直没有发现传播情况。 病例激增是由一种名为本迪布焦（Bundibugyo）的稀有埃博拉病毒引起的。目前还没有针对该物种的疫苗，世界卫生组织表示可能需要几个月的时间才能准备好疫苗。 非洲疾病控制和预防中心（非洲疾病预防控制中心）负责人周二表示，当前的埃博拉疫情有可能成为有史以来规模最大的埃博拉疫情之一，这与美国疾病预防控制中心本月早些时候做出的类似预测相呼应。 与刚果民主共和国接壤的乌干达报告了 19 例确诊病例，其中 2 例死亡。 然而，世界卫生组织（WHO）表示，自 6 月 5 日以来尚未报告任何新病例。 在刚果民主共和国，卫生部表示已加强监测系统、接触者追踪和治疗基础设施，并在几个受影响的城镇设立了专门的中心。 世界卫生组织已承诺...

title.en: Guinea-Bissau: Opposition leader house arrest raises stakes
title.zh: 几内亚比绍：反对党领袖软禁增加赌注

summary.en: Opposition leader Domingos Simoes Pereira remains under house arrest months after the Guinea-Bissau coup, deepening a political crisis and raising tensions with international partners.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Opposition leader Domingos Simoes Pereira remains under house arrest months after the Guinea-Bissau coup, deepening a political crisis and raising tensions with international partners.

Nearly seven months after last year's military coup in Guinea-Bissau , the continued house arrest of opposition figure Domingos Simoes Pereira, leader of the African Party for the Independence of Guinea and Cape Verde (PAIGC), has developed into an international issue.

A Guinea‑Bissau military court earlier this month ordered Pereira to remain under house arrest after fresh questioning over allegations he plotted a coup against the military government, AFP reported, citing his lawyer.

While Portugal and other Portuguese-speaking states are calling for his release, the military leadership in the West African nation's capital, Bissau, dismisses the criticism as interference in national sovereignty.

On November 26, 2025, three days after the presidential election, Guinea-Bissau was waiting for the official announcement of the results by the National Electoral Commission, as most of the votes had already been counted.

At 12:40 p.m. local time,   gunfire and panicked screams erupted around the presidential palace and the National Electoral Commission building. Two hours later, a statement aired on state broadcaster TGB announcing an army takeover .

The electoral commission said on December 2 it could not complete the election process after armed men seized ballots and vote tallies from its offices and destroyed servers storing the results, reported Reuters.

A National Transitional Council took over governance and, under international pressure, announced new presidential and legislative elections for December 6, 2026.

Among the first people arrested was Domingos Simoes Pereira, leader of the African Party for the Independence of Guinea and Cape Verde (PAIGC), and one of the country's most prominent politicians.

"This regime knows that it lacks legitimacy; it was not elected by the people," Pereira said shortly before his arrest.

"Its power rests solely on force. We refuse to accept that," he told DW. "We demand that the political process in our country proceed in accordance with the constitution."

Pereira was released into house arrest in January after being accused of involvement in at least two attempted coups, in 2023 and October 2025.

Pereira's lawyer, Roberto Indeque, said that his client has not been formally provided with any legal justification for his detention.

"Domingos Simoes Pereira has been questioned twice before a military court since his arrest, and those hearings made it clear that he had absolutely no involvement in preparing a coup," Indeque said.

He added that prosecutors had not submitted any request for pre-trial...
body.zh: 几内亚比绍政变几个月后，反对党领袖多明戈斯·西莫斯·佩雷拉仍被软禁，加剧了政治危机并加剧了与国际伙伴的紧张关系。 去年几内亚比绍发生军事政变近七个月后，几内亚和佛得角非洲独立党（PAIGC）领导人、反对派人物多明戈斯·西蒙斯·佩雷拉（Domingos Simoes Pereira）持续被软禁，已发展成为一个国际问题。 据法新社援引佩雷拉律师的消息报道，几内亚比绍军事法庭本月早些时候下令继续软禁佩雷拉，因为他被指控密谋反对军政府的政变。 尽管葡萄牙和其他葡语国家呼吁释放他，但西非国家首都比绍的军方领导层驳斥了这些批评，认为这是对国家主权的干涉。 2025年11月26日，总统选举三天后，几内亚比绍正在等待国家选举委员会正式公布结果，因为大部分选票已经清点完毕。 中午 12:40当地时间，总统府和国家选举委员会大楼周围响起枪声和惊慌的尖叫声。两小时后，国家广播公司 TGB 发表声明，宣布军队接管。 据路透社报道，选举委员会 12 月 2 日表示，武装人员从其办公室夺取了选票和计票结果，并摧毁了存储结果的服务器，因此无法完成选举程序。 全国过渡委员会接管治理，并在国际压力下宣布将于 2026 年 12 月 6 日举行新的总统和立法选举。 第一批被捕的人包括几内亚和佛得角非洲独立党（PAIGC）领导人多明戈斯·西蒙斯·佩雷拉（Domingos Simoes Pereira），他也是该国最著名的政治家之一。 “这个政权知道它缺乏合法性；它不是由人民选举产生的，”佩雷拉在被捕前不久说道。 “它的力量完全依赖于武力。我们拒绝接受这一点，”他告诉德国之声。 “我们要求我国的政治进程按照宪法进行。” 佩雷拉被指控参与 2023 年和 2025 年 10 月至少两次未遂政变，并于 1 月被释放并软禁。 佩雷拉的律师罗伯托·因德克表示，他的当事人尚未被正式提供任何拘留他的法律依据。 因德克说：“多明戈斯·西蒙斯·佩雷拉自被捕以来已在军事法庭接受过两次讯问，这些听证会明确表明他绝对没有参与准备政变。” 他补充说，检察官尚未提交任何预审请求......

title.en: Italy's Meloni says Trump 'made up' story that she 'begged' him for photo at G7
title.zh: 意大利总理梅洛尼称特朗普“编造”她在G7峰会“恳求”合影的故事

summary.en: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni publicly stated that former US President Donald Trump "made up" a story about her "begging" him for a photo at the G7 summit. This highly public disagreement suggests a strain in their previously close relationship, reportedly exacerbated by Trump's decision to go to war with Iran.
summary.zh: 意大利总理乔治娅·梅洛尼公开表示，美国前总统唐纳德·特朗普“编造”了她在七国集团峰会“恳求”与他合影的故事。这次高度公开的争执表明他们之间早先的密切关系已经出现裂痕，据报道，这因特朗普决定与伊朗开战而加剧。

body.en:
Italy's prime minister, Giorgia Meloni, has said she is astonished after President Donald Trump told Italian TV she had "begged" him for a picture with her, in comments that have provoked an open row between the two leaders.

Meloni has said his comments were entirely "made-up", and Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani has cancelled a trip to the US early next week.

The highly public exchange is an indication of how far their earlier close ties have frayed in the months since Trump's decision to go to war with Iran.

Trump and Meloni were seen in close conversation at the G7 summit at Evian-les-Bains in eastern France this week, and the Italian leader later told reporters their relationship was unchanged and there had been "no recriminations".

However, Trump has since given a phone interview with Italy's La7 TV channel in which he alleged: "She begged me to take a photo with her; I felt sorry for her."

The two leaders were filmed several times at Evian, including while they appeared engrossed in conversation on a small sofa, with Meloni smiling as they talked.

"She's probably happy I spoke to her," he said. La7 did not produce Trump's original words in English, but voiced them over in Italian.

Meloni reacted in total disbelief, saying she was "frankly stunned", in a brief address to her seven million followers on Instagram.

"I don't know why the US president behaves this way towards allies," she said, adding it was not the first time it had happened.

"I can only say it is regrettable he does not show the same determination towards the enemies of the West and towards the enemies of the US - [enemies] whose leaders he instead appears to be far more accommodating with."

Meloni's evident shock at Trump's outburst comes after a series of incidents that have weakened what had begun as a close political relationship.

Elected in 2022, Meloni was the sole European leader to attend Trump's inauguration in January 2025 and was widely seen by her EU colleagues as a potential bridge-builder with the US president.

But Meloni has been outspoken in her opposition to the US war with Iran and in April Trump hit back with a phone interview with Italian daily Corriere della Sera in which he said, "I thought she had courage, but I was wrong".

When Trump accused Pope Leo XIV of being "weak on crime and terrible on foreign policy", Meloni said his remarks were unacceptable.

Responding to Trump's latest interview, Italy's President Sergio Mattarella immediately phoned Meloni to offer his support, and figures from across the political spectrum in Italy sprang to her defence.

No-one had the right to speak to an Italian prime minister in such an arrogant tone, said Filippo Sensi, a senator on the left from the opposition Democratic Party.

title.en: The collapse of 'world order' as an opportunity for Asia?
title.zh: “世界秩序”的崩溃对亚洲而言是机遇吗？

summary.en: In Europe, changes to international norms and institutional systems are often interpreted as a loss. However, these changes may also mark the beginning of a new, more inclusive order, particularly as some in Asia view them as an opportunity.
summary.zh: 在欧洲，国际规范和制度体系数十年的变化常被解读为一种损失。然而，这些变化也可能标志着一个更具包容性的新秩序的开始，尤其是在亚洲，有时被视为机遇。

body.en:
In Europe—unlike in Asia—changes to decades of international norms and institutional systems are often interpreted as a loss. However, these changes may also mark the beginning of a new, more inclusive order.

Russia's war of aggression against Ukraine on the European Union's eastern flank, the United States' disregard and contempt for the international order under President Donald Trump, and the allegations that Israel has violated humanitarian law in the Middle East conflict have shocked many Europeans .

The world order that took shape after World War II appears to have come to an end. German Chancellor Friedrich Merz stated at the Munich Security Conference in February 2026: "This order, as imperfect as it was even in its best days, no longer exists in that form." 

However, in Asia, political observers are often surprised at the consternation of some Europeans. During the Shangri-La Dialogue, an annual Asian security conference held in Singapore, former Singaporean diplomat Bilahari Kausikan told DW "Europe thought the jungle had been tamed for good. And then it got a shock."

"Competition and conflict are fundamental characteristics of international relations. These enduring, harsh truths were obscured for a brief period—perhaps about 20 years from the fall of the Berlin Wall to the outbreak of the global financial crisis. This was an extraordinary phase in world history," he added.

Marc Saxer, Asia Pacific head of Germany's Friedrich-Ebert-Foundation, told DW that European and Asian worldviews are shaped by different historical experiences. Under the protective umbrella of United States , Europe was able to dream of a liberal world order. For Asia, that was unthinkable.

Saxer considers efforts to maintain a liberal world order to have failed, and he believes that "a return by the US to the role it played until the 2010s is impossible for structural reasons."

The political analyst said the unipolar era is definitely over, as the US has overextended itself strategically with conflict zones in Europe, the Middle East and the Asia-Pacific.

Thomas Kleine-Brockhoff, director of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP), told DW that the US under Trump is now attempting to "establish a hegemonic world of great powers, a kind of global directorate along with Russia and China," amounting to spheres of influence controlled by great powers.

As a result, international law and multilateral institutions such as the United Nations are being undermined by the United States, China and Russia (each for its own reasons and with its own intentions).

body.zh: 在欧洲，与亚洲不同，几十年来国际规范和制度体系的变化常常被解读为一种损失。然而，这些变化也可能标志着一个更具包容性的新秩序的开始。 俄罗斯在欧盟东翼发动对乌克兰的侵略战争、美国对唐纳德·特朗普总统领导下的国际秩序的无视和蔑视，以及以色列在中东冲突中违反人道主义法的指控，令许多欧洲人感到震惊。 第二次世界大战后形成的世界秩序似乎已经结束。德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨 (Friedrich Merz) 在 2026 年 2 月的慕尼黑安全会议上表示：“这一秩序即使在最好的时候也是不完美的，但现在已经不复存在了。” 然而，在亚洲，政治观察家常常对一些欧洲人的惊愕感到惊讶。在新加坡举行的一年一度的亚洲安全会议香格里拉对话期间，新加坡前外交官比拉哈里·考斯坎 (Bilahari Kausikan) 告诉德国之声：“欧洲原以为丛林已经被永久驯服了。但随后他们感到震惊。” “竞争和冲突是国际关系的基本特征。从柏林墙倒塌到全球金融危机爆发，这些持久而严酷的事实在一段时间内被掩盖了——大约20年。这是世界历史上一个非同寻常的阶段，”他补充道。 德国弗里德里希·艾伯特基金会亚太区负责人马克·萨克瑟向德国之声表示，欧洲和亚洲的世界观是由不同的历史经历塑造的。在美国的保护伞下，欧洲得以梦想建立自由的世界秩序。对于亚洲来说，这是不可想象的。 Saxer 认为维持自由世界秩序的努力已经失败，他认为“由于结构性原因，美国不可能恢复 2010 年代之前所扮演的角色”。 这位政治分析人士表示，单极时代肯定已经结束，因为美国在欧洲、中东和亚太地区冲突地区的战略扩张过度。 德国外交关系委员会(DGAP)主任托马斯·克莱恩-布罗克霍夫(Thomas Kleine-Brockhoff)向德国之声表示，特朗普领导下的美国现在正试图“建立一个大国霸权世界，与俄罗斯和中国一起建立一个全球理事会”，相当于由大国控制的势力范围。 结果，国际法和联合国等多边机构正在受到美国、中国和俄罗斯的破坏（每个机构都有自己的原因和意图）。 萨克瑟出版了一本同名书，他表示，结果是一个“狼世界”，意思是一个“强者法则战胜强者力量的世界……”

reflection.en: The shifting global landscape, where old norms are challenged, highlights the critical need for clear vision. Without a shared understanding of the path forward, societies can drift into uncertainty or chaos. Yet, with thoughtful leadership and a commitment to inclusive principles, these moments of disruption can indeed become opportunities to build a more...
reflection.zh: 全球格局变迁，旧有规范面临挑战，这凸显了清晰愿景的关键性。若缺乏对未来方向的共同理解，社会可能陷入不确定或混乱。然而，若有深思熟虑的领导和对包容原则的承诺，这些颠覆时刻确实能成为建立更公正、更稳定未来的机会。

title.en: 18 dead in Lebanon as Israel retaliates for soldier deaths, ignoring US-Iran deal
title.zh: 以色列无视美伊协议，对士兵死亡进行报复，黎巴嫩18人死亡

summary.en: National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir responded to the deaths of four IDF soldiers with a grave threat: "Lebanon must burn".
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Fighting flared in Lebanon on Friday, with authorities reporting 18 killed in Israeli airstrikes across the south and Israel announcing the deaths of four of its soldiers.

The violence is the worst since the sealing of a US-Iran deal to halt the wider Middle East war, which was supposed to also pause the fighting between Israel and Hezbollah in Lebanon.

The deaths of the soldiers drew a furious reaction in Israel, with far-right Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir saying "Lebanon must burn".

The Lebanese health ministry said the "intensive" strikes "resulted in a preliminary toll of 18 martyrs and 33 wounded" in at least 10 villages and towns.

"The IDF (military) struck more than 80 command centres, terrorists, launch positions, and additional terrorist infrastructure sites in the area of Nabatieh and additional areas in southern Lebanon," an army statement said.

"Furthermore, during the strikes, dozens of Hezbollah terrorists operating in the command centres were eliminated."

Iran-backed Hezbollah, meanwhile, said it was attacking Israeli forces around the southern town of Nabatieh.

Other Israeli strikes targeted the Baalbek region in the east of the country, which had been largely spared since the start of the conflict on 2 March.

Israel said its strikes in Baalbek and the Bekaa Valley were in response to "repeated violations of the ceasefire by Hezbollah", which it said "continues to prepare and carry out terrorist attacks against Israeli soldiers".

Earlier its military announced that Lieutenant Colonel Dor Gedalia Ben Simhon had "fallen in combat" along with three other soldiers whom it did not immediately identify.

A military official said the incident involved an impact from "a suspicious target" on an Israeli tank, with Israeli military correspondents reporting it had been hit by "a suspected drone or anti-tank missile".

In a separate statement the military also reported that a reserve officer was severely wounded "as a result of an explosive drone impact in southern Lebanon", with four other soldiers lightly injured.

"With all due respect to the Americans, Israel must make it clear to the entire world that the blood of our sons and the security of our citizens are not up for bargaining. All of Lebanon must burn," Ben Gvir said in a statement.

"For every tear shed by an Israeli mother, a thousand Lebanese mothers must weep," he added.

title.en: Obama moved to tears by wife Michelle's speech
title.zh: 奥巴马被妻子米歇尔的演讲感动落泪

summary.en: Former President Barack Obama was visibly moved to tears by his wife Michelle Obama's speech during the opening of a new site in Chicago. The former president described the new site as a "celebration of community."
summary.zh: 前总统巴拉克·奥巴马在芝加哥一个新场馆的开幕式上，被妻子米歇尔·奥巴马的演讲感动落泪。这位前总统将该场馆描述为“社区的庆典”。

body.en:
Former US President Barack Obama was visibly moved as his wife Michelle Obama saluted his work during the opening of the new Obama Presidential Center in Chicago.

He appeared to wipe away a tear as the former first lady hailed his achievements in office, including his efforts to expand healthcare and his attainment of a Nobel Peace Prize.

The latter remark was widely interpreted as a jibe at his successor, Donald Trump, who has coveted the same accolade during his own time in office.

Living former presidents Bill Clinton, George W Bush and Joe Biden attended the event but Trump, who has long feuded with the Obamas, was not invited.

The Chicago attraction, a monument to the eight years the couple spent in the White House, has been in the works since Obama, the 44th president, left the Oval Office a decade ago.

The Obamas chose the Jackson Park neighbourhood on the South Side for the 20-acre campus, near the home where they lived before moving to the White House.

Obama said he hoped the centre would "remind us what we can achieve when we embrace our shared responsibilities as citizens".

Michelle Obama used her speech to address her husband directly and salute his resilience. "Barack, you gotta look at me," she said, drawing laughter from her audience. "Eight years in the crucible and not once did you melt from the heat."

Her husband had done "the people's work", she went on to say, touting his record on the economy and the raid that killed Osama Bin Laden, alongside his achievements on healthcare and the Nobel prize.

Barack Obama had been held to a "higher standard" as America's first black president, she added. She told her husband he had battled "lies about your birthright, your faith, your patriotism".

When he took the microphone, Barack Obama addressed the emotions of the day, saying of his wife: "She knew she was going to mess me up, and she did it anyway."

Obama, who was president from 2009-17, told visitors that the centre had been planned as a "vibrant, living celebration of community".

Like his wife, he did not mention Trump by name, but made pointed remarks that were interpreted by analysts as rebukes of the current administration.

He suggested that America was currently experiencing "anger and vision" but that Americans were "looking for fairness and common sense and mutual respect".

Other dignitaries attending Thursday's event included former German Chancellor Angela Merkel and former Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau, who were both in office during Obama's tenure.

Artists including Jennifer Hudson, Christina Aguilera, John Legend, Common, Marc Anthony, U2's Bono and The Edge performed, as well as Bruce Springsteen and Stevie Wonder.

body.zh: 在芝加哥新奥巴马总统中心落成典礼上，美国前总统巴拉克·奥巴马 (Barack Obama) 明显被妻子米歇尔·奥巴马 (Michelle Obama) 向他的工作致敬而感动。 当他的妻子、前第一夫人称赞他在任期间取得的成就时，他似乎擦去了眼泪，包括他为扩大医疗保健所做的努力以及获得诺贝尔和平奖。 后一言论被广泛解读为对他的继任者唐纳德·特朗普的嘲笑，特朗普在任职期间就渴望获得同样的荣誉。 在世的前总统比尔·克林顿、乔治·W·布什和乔·拜登出席了此次活动，但与奥巴马家族长期不和的特朗普没有受到邀请。 这座芝加哥景点是纪念这对夫妇在白宫度过的八年时光的纪念碑，自第 44 任总统奥巴马十年前离开椭圆形办公室以来一直在筹建中。 奥巴马夫妇选择了南区的杰克逊公园社区作为占地 20 英亩的校园，靠近他们搬入白宫之前居住的家。 奥巴马表示，他希望该中心能够“提醒我们，当我们承担作为公民的共同责任时，我们能够取得什么成就”。 米歇尔·奥巴马在演讲中直接向她的丈夫讲话，并向他的坚韧致敬。 “巴拉克，你得看着我，”她说，引来观众的笑声。 “在坩埚里呆了八年，你一次也没有被高温融化。” 她接着说，她的丈夫做了“人民的工作”，并吹捧了他在经济方面的记录和击毙奥萨马·本·拉登的突袭行动，以及他在医疗保健和诺贝尔奖方面的成就。 她补充说，作为美国第一位黑人总统，巴拉克·奥巴马一直被要求遵守“更高的标准”。她告诉她的丈夫，他已经与“关于你与生俱来的权利、你的信仰、你的爱国主义的谎言”进行了斗争。 当巴拉克·奥巴马拿起麦克风时，他谈到了当天的情绪，他谈到他的妻子时说：“她知道她会把我搞砸，但她还是这么做了。” 2009-17 年担任总统的奥巴马告诉来访者，该中心被规划为“充满活力、生动的社区庆典”。 和他的妻子一样，他没有提到特朗普的名字，但发表了尖锐的言论，分析人士将其解读为对现任政府的谴责。 他表示，美国目前正在经历“愤怒和愿景”，但美国人正在“寻求公平、常识和相互尊重”。 出席周四活动的其他政要包括德国前总理安格拉·默克尔和加拿大前总理贾斯汀·特鲁多，他们都在奥巴马任期内任职。 詹妮弗·哈德森 (Jennifer Hudson)、克里斯蒂娜·阿奎莱拉 (Christina Aguilera)、约翰·传奇 (John Legend)、Common、马克·安东尼 (Marc Anthony)、U2 的波诺 (Bono) 和 The Edge 等艺术家以及布鲁斯·斯普林斯汀 (Bruce Springsteen) 和史蒂维·旺德 (Stevie Wonder) 都曾参与演出。 摇滚传奇人物和家乡英雄埃迪·维德 (Eddie Vedder)，出生于伊利诺伊州的乐队主唱。

title.en: US-Iran talks in Switzerland postponed hours after Vance trip cancelled
title.zh: 美国与伊朗在瑞士的会谈在万斯行程取消数小时后被推迟

summary.en: US-Iran talks scheduled to take place in Switzerland were postponed shortly after a trip by Vance was cancelled, with a White House spokesperson noting the complex and unpredictable nature of such negotiations.
summary.zh: 原定在瑞士举行的美国与伊朗会谈在万斯行程取消数小时后被推迟，白宫发言人指出此类谈判的后勤工作从未简单或可预测。

body.en:
Switzerland announced Friday that planned talks following up on the deal to end the Middle East war had been postponed, hours after US Vice President JD Vance's departure for the Alpine country was cancelled.

The signing of the accord this week was intended to end the conflict in Iran, reopen the Strait of Hormuz and begin a 60-day period for talks on wider issues, including Iran's nuclear program.

At the same time, the deal was to halt the fighting in Lebanon, but Israel's military announced on Friday new strikes against Hezbollah targets in the nation's south.

"The planned talks between the US, Iran, Qatar and Pakistan have been postponed," the Swiss foreign ministry said in a message to the Agence France-Presse news agency.

"Switzerland remains ready to facilitate these talks. The relevant preparatory work at Burgenstock is continuing," it added, without providing a new date for the talks.

It followed the announcement Friday from the White House that Vance's trip was cancelled, with a spokesperson saying the "logistics of these negotiations have never been simple or predictable."

In Iran, the Tasnim agency had said "nothing has been confirmed" about the Iranian delegation's trip to Switzerland.

The agreement has been signed separately by US President Donald Trump and his Iranian counterpart Masoud Pezeshkian.

Iran's supreme leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei said Thursday that he had approved the accord, despite reservations, even as the United States lifted a blockade of Iranian ports.

Mojtaba Khamenei, who took over after his father and longstanding ruler Ali Khamenei was killed in an airstrike on the first day of the war on 28 February, said in a written statement that he held a "different view" on the deal, without elaborating.

"But I issued my permission due to the commitment" made by officials including Pezeshkian to "protect the rights of the Iranian nation".

"Face-to-face negotiations" with the United States will be held in the future, but that does not "mean accepting the enemy's point of view", he added.

On Friday, Iran's chief negotiator Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf warned that Tehran would give a "decisive" response if the agreement was breached.

American forces on Thursday lifted their naval blockade of Iranian ports that had prevented ships from sailing to or from the Islamic republic, the US military said, noting that American warships "will remain in the general area".

Activity was still muted in the Strait of Hormuz, the strategic bottleneck for energy shipments that Iran blockaded during the conflict.

title.en: For women in China frustrated by sexism, female comics are offering a release
title.zh: 在中国，女性喜剧演员为厌倦性别歧视的女性提供宣泄出口

summary.en: Standup comedy in China is providing a platform for women to discuss sensitive topics, including sexism, offering a sense of release and shared experience. Performers, however, remain cautious of censorship limits as they navigate this space in venues like a small performing arts theatre in east Beijing.
summary.zh: 中国的脱口秀喜剧为女性提供了一个平台，让她们可以讨论包括性别歧视在内的敏感话题，从而获得宣泄和共同的体验。然而，表演者们在北京东部一家小型表演艺术剧院等场所进行表演时，仍对审查限制保持警惕。

body.en: Standup comedy gives women a space to talk about certain topics that have become more sensitive, while performers remain wary of censorship limits Packed into the upstairs theatre of a small performing arts space in east Beijing, more than 100 people, mostly women, are giddy with anticipation. “Who did you come to see?” asks the MC, fashionably dressed in a faded denim two-piece suit. The answer is bellowed in unison back to him: “Fang Zhuren!” Fang Shaoli, AKA Director Fang ( Fang Zhuren ), has built a cult following in China in the past two years. Decidedly less fashionable than the evening’s host, Fang is dressed in a yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans. Her everywoman attire is part of the appeal. With a stout frame and short, sensible haircut, Fang, who was born in 1975, hails from rural part of east China’s Shandong province. Before discovering the art of standup comedy she worked in factories and on construction sites, but mainly lived as a housewife to a difficult husband. Her jokes riff on the deep sexism that permeates Chinese culture, particularly away from the big urban centres like Beijing and Shanghai. Continue reading...

summary.en: A UK Border Force officer and a Hong Kong trade official have been sentenced to 10 and eight years in prison, respectively, after being convicted of spying for China. These are the first convictions under the UK's National Security Act.

body.en: Peter Wai and Bill Yuen sentenced to 10 and eight years at Old Bailey in first convictions under National Security Act A UK Border Force officer and a Hong Kong trade official based in London have been jailed for spying for China in the first such conviction in British criminal history. Peter Wai, who conducted “shadow policing” operations on Chinese dissidents in the UK, was sentenced to 10 years, while his handler, Bill Yuen, received an eight-year term. Continue reading...
body.zh: Peter Wai和Bill Yuen根据《国家安全法》首次在老贝利被判刑10年和8年。一名英国边防部队官员和一名驻伦敦的香港贸易官员因为中国从事间谍活动而被判入狱，这是英国犯罪史上的首次此类定罪。在英国对中国持不同政见者进行“影子警察”行动的韦彼得被判处10年徒刑，而他的经纪人袁比尔则被判处8年徒刑。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news highlights the profound breach of trust when public officials betray their duties. Yahweh's word reminds us that faithfulness in small responsibilities reflects our character in larger ones. May we all strive for integrity in every role we are given, understanding that honesty builds trust and strengthens the fabric of society.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻凸显了公职人员背叛职责时对信任的严重破坏。雅伟的话语提醒我们，在小事上忠心的人，在大事上也忠心。愿我们都在所担任的每一个角色中追求正直，明白诚实能建立信任并巩固社会结构。

verse.textEn: Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.
verse.textZh: 人在最小的事上忠心，在大事上也忠心；在最小的事上不义，在大事上也不义。

title.en: Inspired by Ukraine, and worried by China: Taiwan teaches its citizens how to fly drones
title.zh: 受乌克兰启发，担忧中国大陆：台湾教导市民如何驾驶无人机

summary.en: Ordinary citizens in Taiwan are enrolling in drone piloting courses, inspired by events in Ukraine and concerned about a potential military threat from China. These courses teach participants, young and old, how to operate drones for various purposes.
summary.zh: 受乌克兰局势的启发并担忧中国大陆的军事威胁，台湾普通民众（包括年轻人和老年人）正在参加无人机驾驶课程。这些课程旨在教授学员如何操作无人机以应对潜在情况。

body.en: Ordinary Taiwanese, young and old, are joining courses to learn how to fly drones amid looming China military threat In a small, crowded room in Taipei, Pan Chien-chin is trying to keep a drone hovering steadily. Imagining himself flying a plane, he gently nudges controller joysticks to guide the insect-like device as it hums through the air. Cheers break out as Pan, who has never flown a drone before, steers it around a rectangular course marked by traffic cones without crashing. Around him are about two dozen fellow trainees, all signed up for the same course: Taiwan’s first civil defence drone training programme. Continue reading...
body.zh: 台湾普通民众，无论老少，都在参加课程，学习如何在迫在眉睫的中国军事威胁下驾驶无人机。在台北一间拥挤的小房间里，潘建钦正努力让无人机保持稳定盘旋。他想象自己驾驶一架飞机，轻轻推动控制器操纵杆，引导昆虫般的设备在空中嗡嗡作响。当潘以前从未驾驶过无人机时，他驾驶无人机绕着一个由交通锥标标记的矩形航线飞行，没有坠毁，引发了欢呼声。他周围大约有两打学员，他们都报名参加同一门课程：台湾首个民防无人机训练计划。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The story highlights a community's proactive response to perceived threats, reflecting a natural human inclination to prepare for potential dangers. Proverbs reminds us of the wisdom in foreseeing trouble and taking steps to protect ourselves and our communities. Such foresight, when coupled with a reliance on Yahweh, can guide us in uncertain times.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻讲述了一个社区如何积极应对潜在威胁，反映了人类为可能出现的危险做准备的自然倾向。箴言提醒我们，预见祸患并采取措施保护自己和社区是智慧之举。这种远见，若能与对雅伟的信靠结合，便能在不确定的时期指引我们。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: Lululemon apologises after Japanese drum row at Great Wall yoga event
title.zh: Lululemon因长城瑜伽活动中的日本太鼓风波致歉

summary.en: The activewear brand Lululemon issued an apology after an online uproar in China. The controversy stemmed from a promotional yoga event held on the Great Wall of China, where a Japanese taiko drum was mistakenly featured instead of a Chinese drum, despite the event being intended to celebrate Chinese culture.
summary.zh: 运动服饰品牌Lululemon因在中国长城举办的瑜伽推广活动中误用日本太鼓而引发网络争议后，发表了道歉声明。尽管该活动旨在庆祝中国文化，但这一失误在中国引发了线上轩然大波。

body.en: Online uproar follows Canadian brand’s use of taiko drum at sponsored festival held to celebrate Chinese culture The activewear brand Lululemon has apologised after a promotional event held on the Great Wall of China appeared to mistakenly feature a Japanese drum, prompting an uproar. The Canadian-headquartered company, known for its upmarket leggings, has been growing rapidly in China and arranged for a yoga festival to take place in late May on a section of the wall near Beijing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 加拿大品牌在为庆祝中国文化而举办的赞助节日上使用太鼓，在中国引起网络轩然大波运动服品牌 Lululemon 在中国长城举行的一次促销活动中错误地使用了日本太鼓，引发轩然大波，该品牌已道歉。这家总部位于加拿大的公司以其高档瑜伽紧身裤而闻名，在中国发展迅速，并于五月底在北京附近的一段长城举办了一场瑜伽节。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This incident reminds us how quickly a seemingly small cultural misstep can ignite widespread public sentiment, especially in the digital age. Just as a tiny spark can set a vast forest ablaze, unintentional actions or symbols can inadvertently cause significant uproar and division. It underscores the need for careful consideration and humility in our...
reflection.zh: 这起事件提醒我们，一个看似微小的文化失误，尤其在数字时代，能多么迅速地引发广泛的公众情绪。正如一点火花能点燃整片森林，无意的行为或象征也可能不经意间造成巨大的争议和分歧。这强调了我们在互动中需要谨慎思考和谦卑，认识到即使是微小的细节也可能产生深远的影响。

verse.textEn: The tongue is a small part of the body, but it makes great boasts. Consider what a great forest is set on fire by a small spark.
verse.textZh: 舌头在百体里也是最小的，却能说大话。看哪，最小的火能点着最大的树林。

title.en: They were forced into marriage and abused. Now women facing exploitation in China have a glimmer of hope
title.zh: 她们被迫结婚并遭受虐待。现在，中国面临剥削的女性有了一线希望

summary.en: Female activists are secretly working to locate and assist vulnerable women in China who have been forced into marriage and subjected to abuse, as they believe authorities are not adequately protecting them.
summary.zh: 在中国，女性活动家们正在秘密寻找并帮助那些被迫结婚并遭受虐待的弱势女性，因为她们担心官方未能提供足够的保护。

body.en: Female activists are working in the shadows to find and support vulnerable women they fear are being failed by authorities Last summer, Xiaocao, a softly spoken woman in her 40s, received a tip-off that in Lüliang, a small city in China’s Shanxi province, vulnerable women were being forced into marriages. Along with another volunteer, she wanted to investigate. After leaving Beijing, the two volunteers travelled south for hours, on trains and in rental cars. A few villages turned out to be dead ends. But on the final day of their trip, the women stopped in a county where they’d heard about a woman with learning disabilities who was “married” to two brothers. Soon, they found her. Continue reading...
body.zh: 女性活动人士正在暗中寻找和支持她们担心当局辜负的弱势女性。去年夏天，40 多岁、说话轻声细语的小曹接到举报，称在中国山西省的一个小城市吕梁，弱势女性正在被迫结婚。她想和另一名志愿者一起进行调查。离开北京后，两名志愿者乘坐火车和租车向南行驶了几个小时。一些村庄变成了死胡同。但在旅行的最后一天，妇女们在一个县停下来，她们听说那里有一名有学习障碍的妇女“嫁给”了两个兄弟。很快，他们就找到了她。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story highlights the courageous work of activists who step in when vulnerable individuals are failed by systems meant to protect them. Their efforts embody the call to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, advocating for justice and dignity for the exploited.
reflection.zh: 这个故事彰显了活动家们的勇气，当弱势群体未能得到应有的保护时，她们挺身而出。她们的努力体现了为那些无法为自己发声的人说话的呼召，为受剥削者争取正义和尊严。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: The Guardian view on the global baby bust: people are having fewer children – even where they say they want more | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》观点：全球生育率暴跌——人们生育的孩子越来越少，即使他们说想要更多 | 社论

summary.en: A new report indicates that global fertility rates are falling faster and spreading further than anticipated, with India's fertility now below the level needed for population stability. This trend means that two-thirds of the world's population now lives in countries with declining birth rates.
summary.zh: 一份新报告指出，全球生育率下降的速度和范围都超出了预期，印度生育率已降至维持人口稳定所需的水平以下。这一趋势意味着全球三分之二的人口生活在生育率下降的国家。

body.en: Indian fertility has fallen below the rate required for population stability, in further evidence of the unexpectedly rapid decline in births internationally The global fall in fertility rates has arrived faster and spread further than anticipated. Two-thirds of people now live in countries that have slipped below the replacement rate – 2.1 births per woman – required for a stable population. Last month, India revealed that its fertility rate had fallen to just 1.9 . The world’s two most populous nations, which pursued cruel and coercive policies to cut births, both face shrinking populations. China’s fertility rate is now around 1, and births last year fell below 8 million – just over half the number projected when the “one child” policy was axed 10 years ago, and comparable to the total in 1738, when its population was 150 million. It’s further proof that what was seen as a phenomenon of rich nations has spread far beyond them. East Asia led the way. But Albania and Chile have far lower rates than the US or England and Wales (themselves experiencing record lows of 1.6 and 1.4). Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? body.zh: 印度的生育率已降至人口稳定所需的水平以下，这进一步证明了国际上出生率出人意料地迅速下降。全球生育率下降的速度和蔓延范围都超出了预期。目前，三分之二的人口生活在人口更替率（每名妇女生育 2.1 胎）以下的国家。上个月，印度透露其生育率已降至仅 1.9。世界上两个人口最多的国家都推行残酷和强制性的政策来减少生育，但都面临着人口萎缩的问题。目前中国的生育率约为1，去年的出生人数跌至800万以下——仅略高于10年前取消“独生子女”政策时预计数字的一半，与1738年的总人口相当，当时的人口为1.5亿。这进一步证明，被视为富裕国家现象的现象已经远远超出了它们的范围。东亚处于领先地位。但阿尔巴尼亚和智利的利率远低于美国或英格兰和威尔士（它们自己也经历过 1.6 和 1.4 的历史低点）。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The global decline in birth rates highlights a significant shift in societal patterns regarding family and future generations. Psalm 127:3 reminds us that children are a heritage from Yahweh, a reward and a blessing that enrich life and carry hope for the future. This perspective invites reflection on the profound value of each new life.
reflection.zh: 全球生育率下降的趋势，反映了社会在家庭和未来世代模式上的重大转变。诗篇127:3提醒我们，儿女是雅伟所赐的产业，是祂所给的赏赐，他们丰富生命，承载着未来的希望。这一视角邀请我们反思每个新生命的深远价值。

verse.textEn: Children are a heritage from Yahweh, offspring a reward from him.
verse.textZh: 儿女是雅伟所赐的产业。

title.en: From camel coats to guochao: Max Mara woos China’s luxury brand consumers
title.zh: 从骆驼绒大衣到国潮：Max Mara如何吸引中国奢侈品消费者

summary.en: Luxury fashion brand Max Mara celebrated its 75th anniversary with a catwalk show in Shanghai, paying tribute to Chinese style to attract consumers in China's growing luxury market.
summary.zh: 奢侈时尚品牌Max Mara在上海举办了75周年时装秀，以中国风情致敬当地文化，旨在吸引中国日益增长的奢侈品市场消费者。

body.en: Fashion house pays tribute to Chinese style with its 75th anniversary catwalk show in Shanghai “New York may be the city that never sleeps, but Shanghai doesn’t even sit down.” For the British designer Ian Griffiths, who encountered this line in the New Yorker, it summed up why China’s biggest city was the right place to celebrate Max Mara’s 75th anniversary. “Max Mara is a product for metropolitan women, and it would be patronising to assume that a metropolitan wardrobe should be western-centric,” Griffiths said. Continue reading...
body.zh: 时装屋在上海举办 75 周年时装秀，向中国风致敬 “纽约可能是不夜城，但上海却从不坐下。”对于在《纽约客》上看到这句话的英国设计师 Ian Griffiths 来说，它总结了为什么中国最大的城市是庆祝 Max Mara 75 周年的最佳地点。 “Max Mara 是一款专为都市女性设计的产品，如果认为都市女性的衣橱应该以西方为中心，那就太居高临下了，”Griffiths 说道。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The allure of luxury fashion and the relentless pursuit of market share highlight the powerful draw of material wealth and worldly success. This story invites us to consider where our ultimate devotion lies, reminding us that our hearts cannot be fully given to both God and the pursuit of riches.
reflection.zh: 奢华时尚的魅力和对市场份额的孜孜不倦，凸显了物质财富和世俗成功的强大吸引力。这个故事邀请我们思考我们最终的忠诚所在，提醒我们不能同时全心全意地侍奉雅伟和追求财富。

verse.textEn: No one can serve two masters... You cannot serve both God and Mammon.
verse.textZh: 一个人不能事奉两个主……你们不能又事奉神，又事奉玛门。

title.en: US military plans major war stockpile on Australian soil
title.zh: 美国军方计划在澳大利亚建立大型战争储备

summary.en: The United States military is planning a significant accumulation of weapons on Australian territory. This move is described as a key part of an Asia-wide regional defense strategy aimed at countering the growing influence of China.
summary.zh: 美国军方正计划在澳大利亚领土上大量储备武器。此举被描述为一项旨在对抗中国崛起势力的亚洲区域防御战略的关键组成部分。

body.en:
The US military is planning a permanent war-ready weapons stockpile for its marine corps on Australia's southeast coast beyond the range of most Chinese missiles, tender documents show and officials confirmed to the Agence France-Presse news agency (AFP).

The development of the stockpile, a first for the US marine corps in Australia, comes as the United States is keen to leverage the continent's strategic location in the South Pacific to counter China's rapid military build-up, analysts said.

The US marine corps began global prepositioning of military supplies during the Cold War — using floating stores on ships and caves in Norway where weapons, ammunition and vehicles to sustain thousands of troops are kept.

The first land stockpile in the Asia-Pacific region is expected to open this year in the Philippines, close to potential flashpoints in the South China Sea.

Documents published by the US navy this month show advanced planning for an even larger Australian stockpile, with US$30 million ($42.4M) allocated to build warehouses and offices in southeastern Victoria state for "critical forward provisioning".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The Australian stockpile, expected to reach full capacity by 2028, will be kept in Melbourne before being moved to US warehouses to be constructed next year at an Australian military base at Bandiana in rural Victoria, tender documents show.

Australia does not permit foreign military bases on its soil, a sensitive issue in a country that has a security alliance with the United States and is hosting an increasing variety of US forces on rotation at Australian defence bases.

The US navy is engaging a global defence contractor to employ around 110 engineers, mechanics, material and safety specialists to manage the Australian stockpile, which includes "crew-served weapons", the documents show.

"Marine corps activities in Australia support integrated global sustainment by maintaining ready-for-issue equipment and supplies for operations and exercises across the Indo-Pacific," a US marine corps forces pacific spokesperson told AFP.

The spokesperson declined to comment on contract details or force planning assumptions but said marines' equipment is kept at "high readiness".

Contracting arrangements and the operation of the facility would be made in close coordination with Australia's Department of Defence.

"These activities improve responsiveness, strengthen interoperability with allies and partners, and support a range of missions across the Indo-Pacific," the spokesperson said, using an alternative description for the Asia-Pacific region.

US army trucks were left at the Bandiana base in 2023 after...
body.zh: 招标文件显示，官员们向法新社（法新社）证实，美国军方正计划在澳大利亚东南海岸为其海军陆战队建立一个永久性的战备武器库存，该武器库位于大多数中国导弹的射程之外。 分析人士表示，这是美国海军陆战队在澳大利亚的首次军备建设，正值美国热衷于利用澳大利亚在南太平洋的战略位置来对抗中国的快速军事集结。 冷战期间，美国海军陆战队开始在全球预先部署军事物资——使用挪威船只和洞穴上的浮动仓库，存放武器、弹药和车辆，以维持数千名士兵的生命。 亚太地区第一个陆地储备预计将于今年在菲律宾开放，靠近南中国海的潜在爆发点。 美国海军本月发布的文件显示，澳大利亚对更大规模的库存进行了高级规划，其中拨款 3000 万美元（合 4240 万美元）用于在维多利亚州东南部建造仓库和办公室，用于“关键的前沿供应”。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 招标文件显示，澳大利亚的库存预计将在 2028 年达到满负荷，将存放在墨尔本，然后转移到明年在维多利亚州乡村班迪亚纳的澳大利亚军事基地建造的美国仓库。 澳大利亚不允许在其领土上建立外国军事基地，这对于一个与美国结成安全联盟并在澳大利亚国防基地轮流驻有越来越多美军的国家来说是一个敏感问题。 文件显示，美国海军正在聘请一家全球国防承包商，聘请约 110 名工程师、机械师、材料和安全专家来管理澳大利亚库存，其中包括“船员服务武器”。 美国海军陆战队太平洋发言人告诉法新社：“海军陆战队在澳大利亚的活动通过为整个印太地区的行动和演习提供随时可用的设备和物资来支持全球综合保障。” 该发言人拒绝就合同细节或部队规划假设发表评论，但表示海军陆战队的装备保持“高度准备状态”。 该设施的合同安排和运营将与澳大利亚国防部密切协调。 这位发言人表示：“这些活动提高了响应能力，加强了与盟友和伙伴的互操作性，并支持印太地区的一系列任务。”他用了对亚太地区的另一种描述。 2023 年，美军卡车被留在班迪亚纳基地……

reflection.en: News of increasing military stockpiles highlights the ongoing global tension and the human tendency to seek security through arms. Yet, the prophetic vision reminds us of a future where nations transform instruments of war into tools for peace. This hope encourages us to pray for leaders to pursue paths that lead to true and lasting peace, rather than...
reflection.zh: 关于军事储备增加的消息凸显了持续的全球紧张局势以及人类通过武器寻求安全的倾向。然而，先知的异象提醒我们，未来各国将把战争工具转化为和平工具。这一希望鼓励我们为领导人祷告，愿他们寻求通往真正持久和平的道路，而非升级冲突。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Charging ahead: EVs outpace growth predictions
title.zh: 电动汽车：超越增长预期，加速前进

summary.en: Electric vehicles are becoming more affordable, efficient, and capable of longer distances, exceeding initial growth forecasts. China is leading this transition, with Europe and other nations rapidly advancing as well.
summary.zh: 电动汽车正变得更便宜、更高效，续航里程也比以往任何时候都长，其增长速度超出了预期。中国正在推动这一转型，而欧洲和其他国家也正在迅速追赶。

title.en: Girlfriends review – love and growing pains in queer coming-of-age tale that goes from Hong Kong to Taiwan
title.zh: 女朋友》影评：一部从香港到台湾的酷儿成长故事，充满爱与成长的烦恼

summary.en: The film "Girlfriends" is a romantic drama by Tracy Choi, following one woman's journey from high school to her mid-30s, exploring love and the challenges of growing up within a queer coming-of-age narrative set between Hong Kong and Taiwan.
summary.zh: 电影《女朋友》是崔允信执导的一部浪漫剧情片，讲述了一名女性从高中到三十多岁的人生旅程，探讨了在香港和台湾之间发生的酷儿成长故事中的爱与成长烦恼。

body.en: A trio of actors play one woman from high school to her mid-30s in Tracy Choi’s thoughtful romantic drama It can stretch credibility a little when an actor plays the same character over a long time span in one film. Richard Linklater solved the problem in Boyhood by shooting scenes over succeeding years; AI and de-ageing effects are now an option. With this intimate queer coming-of-age drama, film-maker Tracy Choi instead casts a trio of actors to play one woman from high school to her mid-30s. The three don’t look particularly alike; their temperaments overlap but are by no means identical. The point is perhaps to show how intense the transitions into adulthood are, how unrecognisable are the people we used to be. Working backwards, Girlfriends begins in Hong Kong, where 34-year-old film director Lok (Fish Liew) lives with her actor girlfriend Bei (Jennifer Yu). Five years earlier, Choi released a feature film, but her career has stalled. She is directionless and restless. Bei is also applying pressure to buy a flat and have a baby. The film then rewinds 12 years, to Taiwan, when Lok was a student with spiky orange hair, known as Choi (played by Elizabeth Tang). Some of the best scenes in the film come when her parents visit from Macau; Choi and her girlfriend Qing (Han Ning) have been pretending to be flatmates. Then, as the four of them eat dinner one night, unwilling to keep up the charade, Choi grabs Qing’s hand fiercely over the dinner table. She is coming out to her parents; they understand but say nothing. Another film might give us a big showdown, but this is probably how it would have happened in real life. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在 Tracy Choi 这部深思熟虑的浪漫剧中，三位演员扮演一名从高中到 30 多岁的女性。当一个演员在一部电影中长时间扮演同一个角色时，可信度会有所提高。理查德·林克莱特在《少年时代》中通过连续几年拍摄场景解决了这个问题。人工智能和抗衰老效果现在是一种选择。在这部亲密的酷儿成长剧中，电影制片人崔西·崔 (Tracy Choi) 聘请了三名演员来扮演一名从高中到 30 多岁的女性。这三个人看起来并不是特别相似。他们的性格有重叠，但绝不相同。重点也许是为了表明向成年的转变是多么激烈，我们过去的样子是多么难以辨认。时光倒流，《女朋友》的故事发生在香港，34 岁的电影导演乐（刘静茹饰）和她的演员女友贝（余珍妮饰）住在一起。五年前，崔发布了一部故事片，但她的事业却陷入了停滞。她没有方向，焦躁不安。贝还施加压力，要求买一套公寓并生孩子。影片随后将时间倒回12年前的台湾，当时乐还是一名留着尖尖橙色头发的学生，名叫崔（伊丽莎白·唐饰）。影片中一些最精彩的场景出现在她的父母从澳门来访时；崔和女友青（韩宁饰）一直假装是室友。然后，有一天晚上，当他们四个人吃晚饭时，崔不愿继续玩这个游戏，在餐桌上猛烈地抓住了庆的手。她向父母出柜了；他们明白但什么也没说。另一部电影可能会给我们带来一场大对决，但这可能就是现实生活中发生的情况。继续阅读...

In every person's unique path of identity and connection, we are reminded of the profound truth that each individual is created in the image of God, possessing inherent dignity and worth.

title.en: Which parties want to cut migration, and how far would they go?
title.zh: 哪些政党希望削减移民，他们会走多远？

summary.en: Migration is back in the spotlight. Here's how the major parties' policies compare.
summary.zh: 移民问题再次成为焦点。以下是主要政党的政策对比。

body.en:
Net migration has fallen to its lowest level since the post-pandemic border reopening — meanwhile the subject is one of the defining political fights of 2026.

New Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) data, released on Thursday, show net overseas migration fell to 301,000 in 2025, down slightly from 306,000 the year before.

Even so, the figure remains above Labor's own targets — with the Coalition and One Nation arguing current levels are still "unsustainable".

The figures were published just a day after One Nation leader Pauline Hanson used her first address to the National Press Club to blame housing pressure on immigration.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

While many experts agree that the level of migration has some effect on housing, they are divided on how significant that effect is.

Matt Grudnoff, senior economist at the progressive political think-tank the Australia Institute, recently told SBS that "data shows that migrants are not having an impact on the housing affordability issues" and in general they have "a positive impact" on the economy.

So how do the major parties actually compare on migration — and is migration really the problem voters are concerned about?

Labor's permanent migration program is capped at 185,000 places for 2026-27 , with 132,240 places — 71 per cent — targeted at skills shortages.

Longer term, the government is aiming for net overseas migration of 225,000 people a year over the next three years.

Treasurer Jim Chalmers has pointed to the latest ABS figures as proof the trend is also lowering, saying migration was "already down 45 per cent since its peak."

On students, Labor's national planning level has a cap of 295,000 international student places for 2026, which it describes as "managed" and "sustainable" growth that supports the international education sector while also maintaining the "integrity of the migration system".

On housing, Immigration Minister Tony Burke has connected migration with the housing crisis, telling Sky News on Monday, "if you go at migration the wrong way, then you can actually make the housing situation worse".

But Labor's primary housing fix is still on the supply side — investing in construction workers, state incentives, and social housing investment — rather than treating migration cuts as the solution.

The Coalition's migration policy centres on what it calls the "Australian values migration plan".

It hasn't committed to a fixed cap, but has hinted at a target "well under 200,000".

It has linked caps to housing, saying that it would cap net overseas migration each year at the number of new homes completed in the...
body.zh: 净移民数量已降至疫情后边境重新开放以来的最低水平——与此同时，这一主题成为 2026 年决定性的政治斗争之一。 澳大利亚统计局 (ABS) 周四发布的新数据显示，2025 年海外净移民人数降至 301,000 人，略低于前一年的 306,000 人。 即便如此，这一数字仍然高于工党自己的目标——联盟党和一国党认为目前的水平仍然“不可持续”。 这些数据是在“一国党”领导人宝琳·汉森在国家新闻俱乐部首次发表讲话将住房压力归咎于移民的一天后公布的。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 尽管许多专家都认为移民水平对住房有一定影响，但他们对于这种影响的严重程度存在分歧。 进步政治智库澳大利亚研究所的高级经济学家马特·格鲁德诺夫(Matt Grudnoff)最近告诉SBS，“数据显示，移民并没有对住房负担能力问题产生影响”，总体而言，他们对经济产生“积极影响”。 那么，主要政党在移民问题上的实际比较如何——移民真的是选民关心的问题吗？ 工党2026-27年永久移民计划的名额上限为185,000个，其中132,240个名额（占71%）针对技能短缺问题。 从长远来看，政府的目标是未来三年每年海外净移民人数达到 225,000 人。 财政部长吉姆·查尔默斯 (Jim Chalmers) 指出，最新的 ABS 数据证明了这一趋势也在下降，他表示，移民“自高峰期以来已经下降了 45%”。 在学生方面，工党的国家规划水平将202​​6年国际学生名额上限设定为295,000个，并将其描述为“有管理的”和“可持续的”增长，支持国际教育部门，同时保持“移民体系的完整性”。 在住房问题上，移民部长托尼·伯克（Tony Burke）将移民与住房危机联系起来，他周一告诉天空新闻，“如果你以错误的方式处理移民问题，那么实际上可能会使住房状况变得更糟”。 但工党的主要住房解决方案仍然是在供应方面——投资建筑工人、国家激励措施和社会住房投资——而不是把削减移民作为解决方案。 联盟党的移民政策以所谓的“澳大利亚价值观移民计划”为中心。 它没有承诺固定上限，但暗示目标“远低于 200,000”。 它已将上限与住房挂钩，表示将每年将净海外移民数量限制为年内竣工的新房数量。

reflection.en: The debate over migration policies often challenges societies to consider how they treat those who seek a new home. Yahweh's ancient command reminds us to treat foreigners residing among us as native-born, loving them as ourselves. title.en: Suspected H5 strain of bird flu detected in WA, may mark first detection in Australia

body.en:
Fears are growing a deadly avian disease that has killed millions of animals worldwide has reached the Australian mainland after the discovery of a suspected case of bird flu.

A single migratory wild seabird potentially infected with the disease had been found in Western Australia, the federal government confirmed on Friday.

"If it is confirmed to be the H5 bird flu, this will be sobering, but not unexpected given the spread globally," Agriculture Minister Julie Collins said.

Test results expected on Saturday will confirm whether it is the H5N1 strain that has killed millions of birds globally.

"There is no evidence of any mass mortality at this time, nor is there any evidence of infection in poultry," Collins said.

The brown skua bird was found on a remote beach at the Cape Le Grand National Park near Esperance, about 700km southeast of Perth.

WA Agriculture and Food Minister Jackie Jarvis said the bird was isolated after it was located in an unwell state on Sunday and died that night.

Preliminary testing by state authorities returned a positive result for avian influenza on Thursday.

Samples were sent overnight to the CSIRO Australian Centre for Disease Preparedness in Geelong for further testing to determine the strain.

"A sick Giant Petrel was also found in the same area and, due to it also being a sub-Antarctic bird, this has also been tested, and we are awaiting results," she said.

The deadly strain of bird flu was detected for the first time on Australian soil in October on the World Heritage-listed Heard Island , which sits some 4000km southwest of Perth.

Scientists who visited Heard Island estimated 13,359 southern elephant seal pups had died from the disease out of a total population of 17,364.

Collins insisted the strain's arrival was inevitable and said the government had been preparing for it as a result.

She downplayed fears it could devastate Australia's farmers, who were still reeling from the fuel crisis caused by conflict in the Middle East.

"This is a single bird, a suspected case and we are as prepared as any country can be," Collins said.

"We have invested early, as we said we would, and those investments are now showing provision ... if this is detected as a case, we will have gotten there early."

State and territory representatives and industry experts were meeting on Friday afternoon to discuss planning.

Opposition agriculture spokesman Darren Chester said the case must be investigated thoroughly to protect the poultry industry, the broader agricultural sector and export markets.

body.en:
Treasurer Jim Chalmers has been forced to concede that the 2026 federal budget knocked some "political paint" from the Labor ship as backlash against their proposed tax reforms continues.

The changes to capital gains tax (CGT) and negative gearing — announced in the budget and due to face final votes in the Senate next week — were difficult decisions but the right ones to make for younger generations, Chalmers has argued.

"If we’re given the choice between taking the easier path politically or doing the more difficult thing, but the right thing in the interests of — particularly first home buyers, young people, workers in the tax system — then it will be worth it," Chalmers told ABC radio on Friday.

"Obviously, there’s a big partisan political campaign against these changes. We understand that. We anticipated that. We expected that. But it’s worth it because our job isn’t just to take the easy political options."

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has come under fire from business owners and political rivals for the changes, with a concerted campaign organised by One Nation to "fire the liar" over the claim that the reforms were not campaign pledges.

Chalmers rebuffed the suggestion that the changes should have been announced before the last election by saying that Labor is focused on delivering effective solutions.

"The more important thing than the politics of this is to get the policy right, to get the substance right," he said.

"Because at the end of the day, what matters most is the tax system and the housing market are broken. We are acting to fix it."

The government has also been accused of "back-flipping" after announcing on Thursday that concessions would be made to the CGT changes they had outlined in their budget .

Under a plan announced in the budget, the existing 50 per cent CGT discount will be scrapped in favour of an indexation system and 30 per cent minimum tax rate from 1 July 2027.

On Thursday, the government announced a concession, with Albanese announcing that the 50 per cent active asset discount — which is applied on top of the standard CGT discount for small businesses with an annual turnover of up to $2 million — would be expanded to cover businesses with a turnover of up to $10 million.

The government has said the changes will benefit 2.7 million small businesses and 98 per cent of all active firms in the country.

Opposition treasury spokesperson Tim Wilson speculated on Friday that the budget would bring down Albanese's leadership and suggested Health Minister Mark Butler would be the ultimate beneficiary.

summary.en: An analysis of sunscreen content on TikTok reveals that misinformation tends to generate more engagement than accurate, scientifically proven information.
summary.zh: 对TikTok上防晒霜内容的分析发现，错误信息比准确、经过科学验证的信息更容易吸引互动。

body.en:
She says it's not difficult to find posts claiming that sunscreen is "toxic" or that chemical sun safety products cause kidney disease.

That's why Wong decided to use her PhD in chemistry to cut through confusion around beauty and skincare claims online. Since she first began about 15 years ago, Wong says the "volume" of online misinformation has only grown.

"If a piece of content has unique, brand-new information that people haven't seen before — it confirms their biases. If it's something that's very scary, then people share it," she said.

Alessandro Marcon is a senior research associate at the University of Alberta's Health Law Institute in Canada and told SBS News he has witnessed a similar trend.

He analysed 971 of the most-viewed TikTok videos across five popular hashtags, including #sunscreen, #sunscreenviral, #spf, #sunscreenreview and #sunprotection. This data set accumulated to over 2.4 billion views on the platform.

While the study found that the majority of posts — 86.6 per cent — promoted sunscreen use, content which contained misinformation attracted "significantly higher" engagement. Videos containing critiques made up 6 per cent of the data set, while content asserting that sunscreen causes harm represented 1.5 per cent.

"These videos were not viewed more often … but they were liked more often, shared more often and more often commented on," Marcon said.

Wong said she believes the methodology used in this study may have "misestimated the prevalence of misinformation on TikTok" because the importance of hashtags in the algorithm have "been declining since perhaps 2022".

The analysis, funded by the Canadian Cancer Society, found that just 6 per cent of videos explicitly mentioned cancer risk reduction as a benefit of using sunscreen.

Marcon acknowledged content "was typically to prevent skin damage. So, talking about cracking skin or peeling skin … to deal with acne or aging".

The Cancer Council says sunscreen is an effective tool in preventing skin cancer, according to decades-worth of scientific research. So why does the misinformation spread?.

Sally Blane, chair of the Cancer Council's national skin cancer committee, described the findings as concerning.

"Skin cancer is Australia's most common cancer. [Around] two in three Australians are diagnosed with skin cancer in their lifetime," she said.

"So, having misinformation out there which can potentially lead to more skin cancers — that's the main concern for us."

reflection.zh: 在一个错误信息能够迅速传播并吸引大量关注的时代，培养辨别力至关重要。雅伟的智慧提醒我们，愚蒙人凡事都信，通达人却步步谨慎。这呼吁我们审慎评估信息，尤其是在关乎我们福祉的方面，而不是仅仅接受那些最吸引人的内容。

verse.textEn: The simple believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps.
verse.textZh: 愚蒙人是话都信；通达人步步谨慎。
